selfAssessment.title: How would you describe your English?
selfAssessment.description: Pick the statement that best matches you right now — there's no wrong answer, this just helps us start you at the right level.
selfAssessment.preA1: I can recognize a few familiar words and very basic phrases.
selfAssessment.a1: I can understand and use familiar everyday expressions and very basic phrases.
selfAssessment.a2: I can communicate in simple, routine tasks on familiar topics.
selfAssessment.b1: I can deal with most situations while traveling, describe experiences, and give reasons for opinions.
selfAssessment.b2: I can interact with fluency, understand complex text, and discuss a wide range of subjects.
selfAssessment.c1: I can express myself fluently and spontaneously, and use language flexibly for social, academic, and professional purposes.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.effectiveNotice: Not yet in effect. Elrefaee English Academy is currently in a private beta; these terms will be finalized before public launch.
terms.s1Body: By creating an account or using Elrefaee English Academy ("ERA", "we", "us"), you agree to these Terms of Service, once finalized. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
terms.s2Body: ERA is intended for adult learners. You must provide accurate registration information and are responsible for activity on your account.
terms.s3Body: You agree not to misuse the service — including attempting to bypass rate limits or access controls, sharing account credentials, or submitting harmful or unlawful content through lessons, exercises, or feedback.
terms.s4Body: Certificates issued through ERA reflect performance on ERA's own assessments at a point in time. They are not an externally accredited qualification unless explicitly stated, and can be independently verified using their unique verification code.
terms.s5Body: ERA is under active development and offered on an as-is, as-available basis during this beta period. Features, including AI-assisted tutoring, may be limited, changed, or temporarily unavailable.
terms.s6Body: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms. You may stop using the service and request account deletion at any time — see our Privacy Policy.
terms.s7Body: To the extent permitted by law, ERA is provided without warranties of any kind, and our liability for any claim relating to the service is limited. This section will be finalized with legal counsel before launch.
terms.s8Body: We may update these terms. Material changes will be announced before taking effect.
terms.s9Body: Questions about these terms can be sent to [support email to be added].

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.effectiveNotice: Not yet in effect. Elrefaee English Academy is currently in a private beta; this policy will be finalized before public launch.
privacy.s1Body: Account information you provide (name, email); your learning activity (lessons completed, exercise answers, assessment and certification results, vocabulary review history); engagement data (XP, streaks, badges); and any feedback you submit through the app.
privacy.s2Body: To operate the service — track your progress, schedule spaced-repetition review, personalize your course placement, issue certificates, and respond to feedback. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.
privacy.s3Body: We use Supabase for authentication and data storage, Vercel for hosting, and Sentry for error monitoring — each processes data on our behalf under their own security and data-processing terms. When AI-assisted tutoring is enabled, conversation content is sent to our AI provider (Anthropic) to generate responses; this feature is not yet active for all users.
privacy.s4Body: We use cookies only to keep you signed in (authentication session cookies). We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.
privacy.s5Body: You can request a copy of your data or account deletion by contacting us at [support email to be added]. Deletion requests are currently handled manually while self-serve tools are being built; deleted accounts are anonymized rather than immediately erased, to preserve the integrity of records like issued certificates.
privacy.s6Body: ERA is intended for adult learners and is not directed at children under 16.
privacy.s7Body: We may update this policy. Material changes will be announced before taking effect.
privacy.s8Body: Questions about this policy can be sent to [support email to be added].
